goal: Verify that a user can successfully create a new account as the Site Host and then navigate the calendar view backward to display previous months.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field.
Click the 'Sign up' button to complete the registration.
Once the dashboard loads showing the calendar for 'June 2026', click the left-pointing arrow button (Previous month) located next to the month title.
Click the left-pointing arrow button again to navigate to the month prior to the current view.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the sign-up page to the main dashboard interface.
The calendar view initially displays 'June 2026' upon successful login.
After the first navigation click, the calendar updates to display 'May 2026'.
After the second navigation click, the calendar updates to display 'April 2026'.
The feed of notes or reminders remains visible and accessible during the calendar navigation.
